decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line sits close to the firm's established system offer. Industry turnover is growing and the product has a dedicated page, so there is no sign of a shortfall against aspirations, and the firm's broad portfolio provides slack to carry it while results mature.

The LED ceiling luminaire line fits the firm's core design-led range. It has had only a short time on the market and shows no evidence of underperformance, so there is no trigger for problemistic search, and it is likely to be kept.
